name: superfix
description: Superfix orchestrator: intelligent front-door for all development work. Accepts a GitHub issue or freeform description, classifies the problem, diagnoses it and stops for approval before fixing, assembles the right skill set, and drives it to an opened PR with CI green. It shows the problem and the fix with annotated screenshots (private repos). It labels the issues that wait for you, can add diagrams of the cause and the change after your yes, keeps private notes about kinds of problems it does not cover yet, and cleans up documents and data files on a copy against checks you approve (criteria mode).
